core_principles.text: Hold the bar at arm's length with elbows completely extended at the start of the movement.
Pull the bar up to the shoulders until the elbows are completely flexed.
Keep the elbows positioned at the sides of the body throughout the entire lift.
Engage the core to stabilize the body and prevent rocking back and forth.
Return the bar to the start position in a slow, controlled manner.

common_mistakes.text: Using momentum to complete the lift.
Rolling the shoulders forward during any part of the lift.
Rocking the body back and forth due to an unengaged core.
